method: Read immutable official commit via jj file show; workspace/CLI manifests before consumers; all original six digests rechecked. Matcher/output inspected for substring polling and top-level error envelope. No executable/native provenance.
notes: Detection geometry and confidence are floating point; width/height must be nonnegative for checked OCR data, positive for a physical target.

run_screen_find_text computes effective_limit from all/limit/default100 and passes it to emit_find_text even for a query. The comment claiming query always passes usize::MAX is inconsistent with the executable call path. Require truncated=false and returned=total=array length; no --all or replacement read is added.
Timeout30 is the existing CLI internal 500ms OCR loop, not a new shell poll or retry of a failed CLI completion.
find_text performs case-insensitive substring matching; the CLI ends its poll when any matched detection exists. Exact Allow selection happens only after that invocation.
output.rs emits top-level code/message and exits nonzero; OCR_TIMEOUT is code 7. The zero-exit error control is explicitly contradictory.
